0022600019.text: The Orlando Magic (1-3, 0-2 on the road... wait, 1-1 on the road) visit the Toronto Raptors (3-1, 2-0 at home) in the fifth game of Orlando's season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup, with the Magic 11th in the East and 1.5 games behind the Southeast leader and the Raptors 4th in the East. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). Toronto leads the season series 1-0, and the Raptors beat the Magic 129-99 in their last meeting in Toronto, a result that followed Orlando's 2025-26 season series loss of 1-2 to Toronto.
